title: Feature request: G5 - Report high-noise readings as raw instead of SGV
symptom: Entries uploaded to Nightscout do not take noise levels into account when using the Dexcom G5. The noise level is available locally, but the MongoDB entries all contain "noise": 1 and report BG values as SGV. This makes it impossible for loop systems to recognize unreliable BG data, potentially leading to critical incidents.
cause: The xDrip Nightscout uploader does not translate the calculated noise values to the Nightscout noise scale, so all entries are reported with noise level 1 (clean) regardless of actual noise.
fix: jamorham implemented a commit to translate the calculated noise values within xDrip to match the Nightscout noise scale, mapping xDrip's NOISE_TRIGGER threshold to "2", NOISE_TOO_HIGH_FOR_PREDICT to "3", and NOISE_HIGH to "4", with "0" meaning unknown noise. This change was available in the Oct 4th xDrip Nightly.
evidence_quote: I plan to add support to translate the calculated noise values within xDrip to ones to match the Nightscout noise scale.
